checks.lead: Magnus Ladulås (pronounced ['lɑːdɵloːs], lit. 'Barnlock'), also known as Magnus Birgersson (c. 1240 – 18 December 1290), was King of Sweden from 1275 until his death in 1290.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
